settings.question: Is it really carry-on approved?
settings.answer: Yes — at 53 × 29 × 33cm it meets carry-on size requirements for most major international airlines, so you can skip checked-bag fees and head straight to your gate.

settings.question: How many outfits can it actually hold?
settings.answer: Up to 38+ items of clothing plus 5 pairs of shoes, all kept organized with our wrinkle-free garment fold and a dedicated shoe compartment.

settings.question: Is the material waterproof?
settings.answer: The shell is crafted from water-resistant PU leather, so light rain and spills wipe straight off. We wouldn't recommend fully submerging it.

settings.question: Can I switch between carrying and rolling?
settings.answer: Yes — the trolley wheels tuck away in seconds, so you can carry it by the shoulder strap or roll it through the terminal, whichever you prefer.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Wipe the PU leather exterior with a damp cloth and mild soap. Avoid machine washing or harsh solvents to keep the finish looking new.

settings.question: Will my clothes actually stay wrinkle-free?
settings.answer: The fold-out garment panel keeps blazers, dresses and suits flat and crease-free during transit — most travelers unpack with zero need to re-iron.
